settings.label: Server name
settings.description: The name players see in their server manager.

settings.label: Join password
settings.description: Players need it to join. Type a new one to change it; it is never shown.

settings.label: Admin password
settings.description: Gives full control in the game's server manager. Prism Satisfactory signs in with it too, so it keeps the new one.

settings.label: Max players
settings.description: How many players can be on at once. Satisfactory is made for up to 4; more works but may lag.

settings.label: Pause when empty
settings.description: Pause the game while nobody is on.

settings.label: Send gameplay data
settings.description: Send anonymous gameplay data to Coffee Stain.

settings.label: Autosave every (seconds)
settings.description: How often the game saves. 300 is every five minutes; 0 turns autosaves off.

settings.label: Autosaves kept
settings.description: How many autosaves are kept before the oldest is overwritten.

settings.label: Save when a player leaves
settings.description: Save the game whenever someone disconnects.

settings.label: Daily restart (minutes after midnight)
settings.description: The server restarts itself once a day at this time, in minutes after midnight. 1440 means never.

settings.label: Network quality
settings.description: How much the server sends to each player. Higher is smoother but needs more upload.

settings.label: Join timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long a joining player may take to connect.

settings.label: Connection timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long a player may go without answering before they are dropped.
